source.name: Cost Accounting Production Costing by GMSoft

mapping.summary: Absorbs actual production overhead into BC costs on IAS 2 normal capacity.
claims: Collects overhead from G/L accounts, dimension rules or BC Cost Accounting into pools
Distributes service-center pools to production centers, direct or reciprocal
Absorption rate from capacity ledger, budget or manual entry
Unabsorbed fixed overhead is expensed, not inventoried
Writes rates to work and machine center overhead or posts tagged journals, with preview and reversal
Reconciles collected vs applied overhead with spending and volume variance
Premium: year-end recost on actuals with revaluation of produced items
Premium: lower of cost and NRV review per item
Cost periods with close cockpit, locks and reversal chains
Scheduled runs via job queue and Power BI API pages
Only users who run costing need a licence; 30-day trial
